svg.aria-label: Pulse. In development · team project. A city of about 150 residents that lives on its own. Ask anyone why they did something, change the city in plain English, and replay the day. Built with TypeScript, three.js and Fastify. The screenshot shows the simulated city from above, with its districts and streets.
